body:
Bug confirmed, caused by:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/7960d1879d87f1d9e4f7f202423960d874a6a08f/packages/core/src/di/injectable.ts#L108

Because static properties also got inherited.

Which is technically a regression (only for RC) caused by https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/22943.

issue.title: fix(core): support inheritance between injectables
